The retrieved documents don't include the final 2002 championship standings, so I can't confirm the runner-up from them. The race results show Michael Schumacher winning several races and Rubens Barrichello finishing second or first in others, both driving for Ferrari. From general knowledge (not the documents), Barrichello was the 2002 runner-up behind Schumacher, and he drove for Ferrari.

ANSWER: Ferrari
